title: Protecting Children Online
paragraphs: As his eldest daughter approached her teenage years and requested her own smartphone, Ridwan struggled to balance reasonable independence against genuine concerns about the risks she might encounter online.

Rather than either refusing the request entirely or granting unrestricted access, he researched parental control tools and had an honest conversation with his daughter about the specific reasoning behind whatever restrictions they ultimately agreed upon together.

His daughter initially resisted certain limitations, arguing that classmates faced no similar restrictions, but Ridwan explained his reasoning transparently rather than simply imposing rules without meaningful discussion.

A year later, having gradually adjusted the restrictions as trust developed through demonstrated responsible behavior, Ridwan believes the collaborative approach taught his daughter genuine digital judgment rather than simply enforcing temporary rules she would abandon once unsupervised.
